text:
cass: Huge thanks to omar and jen for swooping in during the build panic last night. you two = legends :sparkles:
omar: team hustle! found the flaky mock and rolled a revert, CI cleared after that.
jen: ran the extra test matrix and added a tiny guard. PR: https://git.internal/r/7890
ryan: sending confetti. can we get a short note for next stand so the rest of the team sees this?
cass: yes please — also proposing a small treat: cookie cart on friday? whos in? :cookie:
omar: Im in. extra cookie if someone writes a mini postmortem blurb.
jen: wrote a 2-line note in the incident thread. linking: https://wiki.internal/notes/build-flake-0526
ops-bot: FYI: Free kombucha in the kitchen until 4pm today :beverage_box: 
ryan: people-ops, nominating omar + jen for this week's kudos shoutout. @people-ops
jen: thanks all, made the all-hands prep much less stressful. :heart:
cass: seriously — appreciate the late-night eyes. omar + jen = coffee + sticker winners.
omar: honored. sticker idea: "Flake Tamer"? :laughing:
jen: +1 for "Flake Tamer" sticker. also tiny enamel pin pls.
ryan: vote casted + sticker design request submitted to design.
cass: OK wrapping up — cookie cart on friday, badge on kudos board, and a huge thanks. you rock.
